:::{#exr-prac-exp-mle-score}
#### Score function of the exponential

In the setting of @exr-prac-exp-mle, use the [log-likelihood](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-loglik) from @exr-prac-exp-mle to derive the [score function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-score)
$\score(\pmean; \vx) = \deriv{\pmean}\llik(\pmean; \vx)$.

:::
